description: DUFFING DAMPED OSCILLATOR - a chaotic-dynamics generator with NO audio input (input_arity 0). Synthesizes the response of a forced Duffing oscillator driven at frq (CDP-enforced 0.1-200 Hz - a LOW-FREQUENCY driver by design; the manual says 1-200, the binary allows 0.1) with damping 0.15-2 and damping-character coefficients k (-10 to 10) and b (20-50). MANUAL DIVERGENCE (first-class): cr8new.htm states 'In tests the damping parameter seemed to have no effect' - on this build damping VERIFIABLY WORKS: damping 0.2 vs 1.5 render different audio, and a 0.2->1.8 damping envelope differs from both scalar endpoints (breakpoint-capable). frq is also breakpoint-capable (20->150 verified against both endpoints; envelope values validated against the 0.1-200 range inside the brkfile: 'Value (440.000000) out of range (0.100000 to 200.000000) in brkpntfile ...'). Output duration is set sample-exactly by dur; output mono; PEAK IS 1.0 - FULL SCALE, the hottest signal in this tranche (headroom warning). Deterministic (identical params byte-identical). The banner's mode list says 'frq, amplitude and damping can vary through time' but NO amplitude argv slot exists - banner slip.
musical_use: A physical-chaos drone box: the Duffing equation lives between oscillation and chaos, so small parameter moves flip the output between gritty sub-tones, period-doubled growls and noisy shrieks. frq is the driving rate (sub-audio to 200 Hz) - treat it as the 'rev' knob; damping is the character knob, and BREAKPOINTING damping across a take sweeps the system through bifurcations in one render (verified live). k and b tilt the damping nonlinearity - keep b low (20-25) for rougher behavior, high (45-50) for steadier tones. Use it for engine-room drones, distressed sub-bass, and as an exciter into filter bank or waveset distortion. WARNING: renders at 0 dBFS peak - attenuate immediately (modify loudness) before mixing; summing it raw with anything clips.

srate.description: Output sample rate, range gate 16000-96000 (family refusal verbatim, re-checked in mode 1: 'Parameter[2] Value (11025.000000) out of range (16000.000000 to 96000.000000)'). Positional - always emitted (default 44100).

dur.description: Output duration in seconds - sample-exact (2.0 -> 88200 frames verified). Required.

frq.description: Driving frequency of the forced oscillation, CDP-enforced 0.1 to 200 ('Parameter[3] Value (220.000000) out of range (0.100000 to 200.000000)'; the manual says 1-200 - binary allows lower). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 20->150 differs from both endpoint renders; envelope values are range-checked inside the brkfile verbatim).

damping.description: Damping of the forced oscillation, CDP-enforced 0.15 to 2 ('Parameter[4] Value (0.100000) out of range (0.150000 to 2.000000)'). WORKS despite the manual's 'seemed to have no effect' note: scalar 0.2 vs 1.5 differ, and a 0.2->1.8 envelope differs from both endpoints - BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified).

k.description: Damping-nature coefficient, CDP-enforced -10 to 10 ('Parameter[5] Value (-11.000000) out of range (-10.000000 to 10.000000)').

b.description: Damping-nature coefficient, CDP-enforced 20 to 50 ('Parameter[6] Value (19.000000) out of range (20.000000 to 50.000000)').

examples.description: Chaotic engine drone at 80 Hz drive.
examples.expected_use: No input argument. Renders at FULL SCALE - attenuate immediately when layering.

examples.description: Bifurcation sweep: damping walks the system through regimes while the drive climbs.
examples.expected_use: Both envelopes verified live; expect regime flips - growl to shriek - rather than smooth morphs.

known_issues: OUTPUT PEAKS AT 1.0 (0 dBFS) - the hottest generator in the family; attenuate before any mixing or the sum clips.
MANUAL DIVERGENCE: cr8new.htm claims damping 'seemed to have no effect'; on this build it verifiably changes the render and is breakpoint-capable.
The banner's 'amplitude can vary through time' names no real argv slot - there is NO amplitude parameter at all (banner slip).
frq ceiling is 200 Hz (a driving rate, not an audio pitch) - the audible spectrum extends far above it through the nonlinearity.
Deterministic: no seed, no clock dependence.
Generator entry: process() takes no input argument; graph()/batch()/sweep() refuse arity-0 entries (arity_zero_unsupported).
